com.airline.building.airfield.desc: A landing pad for vertical take-off and a hangar in one building. Surplus that other colonies want is collected from the warehouse onto its export racks; the pilot carries it to the aircraft and flies it out on scheduled flights. What arrives goes into the stash, and couriers bring it to the warehouse.
com.airline.gui.airfield.export: Export table: stacks to keep in the warehouse
commands.airline.no_colony: There is no colony %s in this dimension.
commands.airline.want.added: %s now wants %s x %s from the air network.
commands.airline.want.line.automatic: Colony %s (%s) is short of %s x %s (read from its open requests)
commands.airline.export.set: Export table: %s, keep %s stack(s) in the warehouse.
commands.airline.net.empty: There is no air network in this dimension.
commands.airline.net.summary: Air network: %s points, %s lines (clear %s, blocked %s, not verified %s). Verifications waiting: %s
commands.airline.net.point.airfield: Airfield pad at %s, landing heading %s degrees (reach %s, lines %s)
commands.airline.net.point.airfield.maps: Airfield pad at %1$s, landing heading %2$s degrees (level %3$s: reaches the airfields on %4$s x %4$s large maps, buoys within %5$s blocks; lines %6$s)
commands.airline.net.line.unseen: %s - %s: not verified (parts are not loaded), %s blocks long
commands.airline.net.line.blocked: %s - %s: BLOCKED, %s blocks long, by the block at %s
commands.airline.net.no_route: There is no way from %s to %s.
commands.airline.flight.off: The flying part is switched off: it needs Sable, Create Aeronautics and ColonyPatch Server.
commands.airline.flight.no_pad: That airfield's landing pad is not on the air network.
commands.airline.flight.pad_taken: An aircraft stands on that landing pad, is expected there, or has its home there.
commands.airline.flight.bad_design: The aircraft could not be made (see the server log).
commands.airline.flight.no_design: There is no aircraft design '%s'. The designs are: %s.
commands.airline.flight.unfit: The hull is damaged, so the aircraft cannot fly until it is repaired: add %s to the airfield's inventory!
commands.airline.flight.no_fuel: Not enough fuel for this flight: the tank holds %s minutes, the flight needs %s. Put fuel (coal, charcoal) on the airfield's racks, or into the aircraft's own block by hand.
commands.airline.flight.too_far: This flight is too far for this aircraft: it needs fuel for %2$s minutes, and the tank holds %1$s minutes at most. A faster aircraft can fly it.
commands.airline.flight.note.waiting_for: A flight waits for fuel: the tank holds %s minutes, the flight needs %s. Put fuel (coal, charcoal) on the airfield's racks.
commands.airline.flight.note.too_far: A flight cannot leave: it is too far for this aircraft. It needs fuel for %2$s minutes, and the tank holds %1$s minutes at most. A faster aircraft can fly it.
commands.airline.flight.note.distress: An aircraft is out of fuel and stays where it is, at %s %s %s, with its pilot on board. Bring it fuel: use its own block with coal or charcoal (about %s pieces of coal are needed to go on).
commands.airline.flight.note.rescued: The aircraft has fuel again and goes on with its flight.
commands.airline.flight.status.fuel: fuel: %s minutes of flight in the tank
message.airline.yard.started: Building an aircraft here: %s (%s blocks to go). The colony's builders put it up from its blueprint and ask for the materials as for any decoration; you may also build it by hand. Use this block with an empty hand to build another design.
message.airline.yard.design: Building this design instead: %s (%s blocks to go).
message.airline.yard.done: The aircraft is finished: %s, on the landing pad at %s %s %s.
message.airline.yard.pad_taken: An aircraft stands on that landing pad, is expected there, or has its home there.
message.airline.yard.lacks: The hull is damaged, so the aircraft cannot fly until it is repaired: add %s to the airfield's inventory!
message.airline.fuel.put: %s put into the tank. It now holds %s minutes of flight.
message.airline.fuel.full: The tank is full (%2$s minutes of flight).
message.airline.fuel.request: Fuel for the aircraft (coal or charcoal)
commands.airline.flight.no_room: There is no room on the landing pad: something is in the way at %s %s %s.
commands.airline.flight.spawned: A new aircraft stands on the landing pad at %s %s %s.
commands.airline.flight.busy: That aircraft is busy with a flight.
commands.airline.flight.no_aircraft: No aircraft stands on that airfield's landing pad.
commands.airline.flight.no_pilot: That airfield has no pilot who is present.
commands.airline.flight.no_route: There is no way between the two airfields on the air network.
commands.airline.flight.sent: The flight is ordered: %s points, %s blocks. The pilot is walking to the aircraft.
commands.airline.flight.none: No aircraft is loaded in this dimension.
commands.airline.flight.note.not_boarded: Flight cancelled: the pilot did not reach the seat in time.
commands.airline.flight.note.not_left: The pilot cannot get off the landed aircraft. It stays fixed and waits; please have a look.
commands.airline.flight.note.cancelled: Flight cancelled: the way was blocked and there was no other; the aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_way_back: The aircraft stays where it landed: there is no way back (or no pilot).
commands.airline.flight.note.blocked: An aircraft found its line blocked by the block at %s %s %s. It goes back to the last point.
commands.airline.flight.note.turning_bac: No other way to the destination: the aircraft returns to where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.waiting: An aircraft is blocked ahead and behind (or another ship is in its way). It keeps its height and waits.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_pilot_in: An aircraft was in the air for a minute without its pilot on the seat. It is given up: fixed where it is, no longer kept loaded. Please have a look.
commands.airline.flight.no_floor_there: The landing pad there has no floor (the airfield is not built). The flight is not ordered.
commands.airline.flight.not_built: The airfield of the destination is not built yet.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_floor: The landing pad at %s %s %s has no floor. The aircraft returns to where it started; the flight is cancelled.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_floor_st: The landing pad at %s %s %s has no floor and there is no way back. The aircraft is fixed in the air above it; please have a look.
commands.airline.flight.status: Aircraft: %s. From %s to %s. Cargo out / back: %s. %s
commands.airline.flight.cancel.too_late: There is nothing to call off: the aircraft is already on its way back, landing, or finishing.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.turning: The flight is called off. The aircraft returns to where it started and lands there.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.before: The flight is called off before take-off. Cargo that was loaded goes back onto the export racks.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.ended_the: The flight ends on the pad where the aircraft stands (%s %s %s). It does not fly back by itself.
commands.airline.flight.note.calling_off: A flight was called off by command.
commands.airline.flight.note.called_off: Flight called off by command: the aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.ended_there: A flight was ended by command where the aircraft had landed.
commands.airline.flight.note.failed_on_p: Flight cancelled: the aircraft's controller failed on the pad (see the server log). The aircraft stays on its pad and can be used again.
commands.airline.flight.clear.none: No given-up aircraft is loaded here. (Go near it first: an aircraft that was given up is not kept loaded.)
commands.airline.flight.clear.given: Took away %s given-up aircraft. The %s items from the hold are in your inventory (what did not fit lies at your feet).
commands.airline.flight.clear.dropped: Took away %s given-up aircraft. The %s items from the hold were dropped where it was, at %s.
commands.airline.flight.history.none: No cargo flight has been recorded yet.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_way_out: It is time to leave, but there is no route to the destination, or no landing pad is free there. The aircraft waits on its pad.
commands.airline.flight.table.standing: Timetable: aircraft of home %s. Berthed on pad %s (%s). Leaves in %s. Next stop %s, expected there in %s
commands.airline.flight.table.flying: Timetable: aircraft of home %s. In the air. Bound for %s, expected in %s
commands.airline.flight.note.nobody_carr: For two minutes no pilot has carried the cargo (asleep, cannot leave the seat, gone). The aircraft waits on its pad.
commands.airline.flight.note.pilot_canno: The pilot could not walk to where the cargo changes hands and handed it over from where it stood. If this goes on, look at the way between the aircraft and the racks.
com.airline.gui.timetable.departure.none: No aircraft stands on this pad.
com.airline.gui.timetable.departure.load: Time to leave. It goes as soon as the cargo is handled.
com.airline.gui.timetable.arrival.none: No aircraft is on its way here.
com.airline.gui.timetable.arrival.flying: The aircraft of %s is flying here.
com.airline.gui.timetable.arrival.berthe: The aircraft of %s is waiting to leave.
com.airline.gui.timetable.aircraft.none: None. Order one on the "Aircraft" page.
com.airline.gui.timetable.aircraft.lacks: The hull is damaged (%s kinds of parts missing); it cannot fly until repaired.
com.airline.gui.timetable.aircraft.distr: Out of fuel in the air. Bring it fuel.
message.airline.buoy.tip: Reaches %s blocks. Set it down within reach of a buoy or an airfield's landing pad; the lines join by themselves.
message.airline.buoy.no_network: The air network has no point yet. Build an airfield first, then set buoys within reach of its landing pad.
message.airline.buoy.too_far: Too far: the nearest point is %s blocks away (this buoy reaches %s).
message.airline.buoy.placed: Air buoy (grade %s, reach %s) joined the air network. Lines: %s clear, %s blocked, %s not verified.
message.airline.buoy.info: Air buoy (grade %s, reach %s). Lines: %s clear, %s blocked, %s not verified.
message.airline.buoy.blocked: The line to %s %s %s is blocked by the block at %s %s %s
message.airline.buoy.leads_to: Airfields it leads to (way in blocks): %s
message.airline.buoy.leads_nowhere: It does not lead to any airfield yet.
message.airline.link.made: An air route is open: %s and %s (%s blocks).
message.airline.link.lost: An air route is lost: %s and %s. A buoy is gone or a line is blocked.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.coming_ho: The flight is called off. The aircraft stops handling cargo and flies home at once; what is left in its hold goes back onto the export racks at home.
commands.airline.flight.note.coming_home: A flight was called off by command. The aircraft flies home.
commands.airline.flight.note.cannot_go_h: An aircraft that wants to fly home has waited on the pad at %s %s %s for 20 minutes (no pilot, or no route). It goes on waiting while somebody is near.
commands.airline.flight.note.pilot_full_: The pilot's pockets are full, so it cannot carry cargo. The goods were moved without it. Have a look at what the pilot carries.
commands.airline.flight.no_free_pad: No landing pad is free at that airfield. (A pad takes one aircraft, and an aircraft's home pad is kept for it: an airfield of level 1 with an aircraft of its own takes no visitors. Level 2 adds a pad for visitors.)
commands.airline.flight.note.other_pad: The landing pad at %s %s %s cannot be used (no floor, or an aircraft stands on it). The aircraft lands on the airfield's other pad.
commands.airline.flight.note.pad_taken: An aircraft stands on the landing pad at %s %s %s. The arriving aircraft returns to where it started; the flight is cancelled.
commands.airline.flight.note.giving_way: An aircraft has waited for another ship in its way and there is no way round. It gives its flight up and goes back to where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.gave_way: Flight cancelled: another ship was in the way and there was no way round. The aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.which: Several flights are under way. Say which: /airline flight cancel <colony> (the colony the aircraft belongs to).
commands.airline.flight.forget.none: The timetable has no aircraft of that airfield that is not loaded right now.
commands.airline.flight.forget.done: The timetable forgot %s aircraft of that airfield. Its pad is free again. (An aircraft that still exists comes back into the timetable when it is loaded.)
message.airline.buoy.barred: The line to %s %s %s cannot be used: it passes too low over the landing pad at %s %s %s, where an aircraft may stand. (Set this buoy higher, about 8 blocks above the pad's floor, or to the side.)
commands.airline.net.line.barred: Line %s - %s (%s blocks): not used. It passes too low over the landing pad at %s, where an aircraft may stand.
commands.airline.flight.note.going_round: An aircraft has waited for another ship in its way. It goes round: back to the last point, and on over other lines.
com.airline.gui.aircraft.none: This airfield has no aircraft yet. Choose a design below to have one built (the colony's builders put it up on the airfield's landing pad).
com.airline.gui.aircraft.building: Being built: %s (%s blocks to go). You can switch to another design below.
com.airline.gui.aircraft.exists: This airfield's aircraft: %s. No new one can be ordered while it exists.
com.airline.gui.aircraft.unavailable: Aircraft cannot be built: the mods flying needs (Sable, Create Aeronautics, ColonyPatch Server) are not installed.
message.airline.yard.pad_blocked: Something stands on the middle of the airfield's landing pad (%s %s %s), so building cannot begin. Clear it and ask again.
message.airline.yard.no_site: No aircraft is being built at this airfield.
message.airline.yard.stopped: Building stopped. The blocks already put up stay where they are.
message.airline.yard.not_allowed: Only those who may manage the colony's huts (owner and officers) can order an aircraft.
message.airline.yard.repair_on: Self-repair is on. An aircraft parked at home is put back the way its design has it (missing parts come from the airfield's racks).
message.airline.yard.repair_off: Self-repair is off. Changes made to the aircraft by hand are kept, and it flies even with parts missing.
message.airline.depart.nothing: There is nowhere to carry goods to right now (no colony can be reached over the air network, or nothing another colony wants lies on the export racks).
message.airline.depart.soon: Berth cut short. The aircraft leaves as soon as loading and unloading are done.
message.airline.depart.none: No aircraft that could leave stands on this airfield's pads.
